task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .
Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves your tree as a family tree file.
saves it with any pictures as well.

step.cmd: If you chose , choose a version.

info.p: The box named offers and . Choose the first unless a program you use is old.

step.cmd: When Windows asks where to put the file, choose a folder you will remember.

info.p: Windows opens your Documents folder first. Choose the folder you want, then choose Save.

stepresult.p: A message names the file and its folder. It stays until you choose it.

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new copy after you add a lot. Keep one on a USB stick or another drive too.
result.note: If you opened a file from another program, saves your changes to that file. To leave the original alone, make a copy first and open the copy. Keep the original safe too.
